overall: The AG found the Marblehead Select Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law. The Complete Streets Committee was a separate body, and the Board's approval of its 2019 minutes was not a violation.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board untimely approved 2019 Complete Streets Committee minutes, doing so over three years after the meetings.
Complaint targeted only the Board for approving Committee minutes, though the Committee was a separate body and had disbanded.
allegations.key_passage: we find no basis for finding a violation by the Board relating to its approval of Committee meeting minutes.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the approved 2019 Committee minutes were insufficient, lacking attendee lists and attribution.
allegations.key_passage: As a preliminary matter, there has been no suggestion that the Committee was a subcommittee of the Board nor that the Board was obligated to approve the Committee’s meeting minutes.
